title: Range
description: Styles a native range input, keeping it a real form control.

showValue.description: Shows the current value in an <output> above the slider. showValue="false" turns it off.

showLabels.description: Shows the min and max values below the slider.

valuePrefix.description: Text before the shown value, e.g. "$".

valueSuffix.description: Text after the shown value, e.g. "%".

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
